extracted.name: Mai Tai II
extracted.description: Mai Tai - a tropical and fruity rum drink.
instruction_lines: Fill a 12 ounce glass with ice cubes. Pour in rum and amaretto. Fill remainder of glass with half orange juice and half pineapple juice. Add a splash of grenadine for color.
